answer_1.quote: we propose a novel conversational graph (CG) grounded policy learning framework for open-domain multi-turn conversation generation (CG-Policy).

answer_2.quote: Dist-i calculates the ratio of distinct i-gram in generated responses. We use Dist-2 to measure the diversity of generated responses.

answer_4.quote: We ask three annotators to judge the quality of each dialog (at multi-turn level) or utterance pair (at single-turn level) for each model.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate dialogs based on incoherence problems for global coherence, and responses for local appropriateness (0 if inappropriate, 1 otherwise) and informativeness (0 if safe response, 1 otherwise).
